title: This is a really cute set.
text: This is a really cute set.. I didn't receive the sham with my set.  The set is cute. The sheets wash well.  I threw the comforter in the dryer because I'm afraid if I wash it, the batting will bunch up.  The color is pretty.  I really like it. I just can't find the sham.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Reversible Microfiber Bed-in-a-Bag with Elastic Storage Pockets - 3 pieces, Full/Queen, Navy Stripe
features: Includes 90 x 90 inch comforter, two 20 x 26 inch shams, 90 x 102 inch flat sheet, 60 x 80 inch fitted sheet, and two 20 x 30 inch pillowcases
Reduce your beside clutter; fitted sheet has 6 x 7 inch elastic pockets on each side that provide storage for your cellphone, television remote, and more.
100% 85 GSM polyester microfiber for a soft hand-feel and cozy comfort; Polyester comforter fill
All-around elastic on 14-inch fitted sheet allows for snug, secure fit of most mattress sizes up to a 16-inch mattress depth
Machine wash warm, tumble dry low; use only non-chlorine bleach if needed
Made in Green factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards
